issue_title_zh: 美股忙周开局：指数分化、科技股拖累、油价与 CPI 成焦点
lead_zh: 今天读美联社（AP）周一收盘综述。标普微跌、道指收涨、纳指走弱——能源涨、芯片跌，典型“指数分化”。重点看：wavering / dragged … into the red / frenzy / closely-watched / settle at 这类财经套话。

article.title: US stocks hover near their latest record in mixed trading on Wall Street
article.author: Damian J. Troise and Alex Veiga
article.excerpt_note: 节选自原文开篇、科技股拖累与油价/经济数据段落（约 405 词）。版权归 The Associated Press 所有，仅供个人学习，完整报道请看原文。
sections: Wall Street kicked off a busy week on Monday with a mixed finish for the major U.S. stock indexes, although the market remained near its all-time high.
The S&P 500 slipped 0.1% after wavering between small gains and losses. The benchmark index set a record high last Tuesday and is up 14% so far this year.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.4%, and the Nasdaq composite fell 0.4%.
Shares in roughly 64% of the companies in the S&P 500 rose, led by communication services stocks. Meta Platforms rose 3.4%, T-Mobile added 2.2%, AT&T gained 1.4% and Verizon Communications rose 2.7%.
Energy stocks had some of the biggest gains as oil prices kept rising. Chevron rose 1.4%.
Despite those gains, a slide in big technology stocks dragged the market into the red.

Micron Technology fell 3.9%, Advanced Micro Devices dropped 2.3%, Broadcom slid 1.9% and Nvidia gave up 1.3%. They are among several companies in the sector with big stock values that tend to have a heavy influence on the market. They have also been the driving force behind the broader market’s record gains throughout the year.

Those companies could face more scrutiny from investors during this round of corporate earnings as Wall Street tries to get a better sense of whether the stock gains made during the frenzy over artificial intelligence can translate into future growth.
Stocks are reaching for records often because of the tech sector, but remain very volatile on a daily basis, partly because of big shifts in oil prices and their impact on bond yields and inflation.

The price of Brent crude, the international standard, rose 1.8% to settle at $106.65 per barrel. Prices have been swinging between $96 and nearly $110 over the last month over uncertainty about the U.S. war with Iran and its continued impact on global energy supplies and inflation.

The surge in energy prices and its impact on the broader economy will be a key focus this week as Wall Street reviews several important economic updates. They include fresh data on the housing market, inflation and retail sales.

The big updates this week involve reports about inflation hitting consumers and businesses. On Wednesday, the government will release the closely-watched consumer price index, or CPI, which measures price changes for a wide range of products and services. Economists expect the index to show the rate of inflation worsened to 3.6% in September from 3.4% in August.

notes.head: kick off
notes.zh: 开场、拉开序幕。kick off a week / meeting / season。本义踢球开球，财经新闻写“一周交易开局”极常用。

notes.head: mixed
notes.zh: 涨跌互现的、结果不一的。a mixed finish / session = 三大指数有涨有跌。反义 broad rally / selloff。

notes.head: all-time high
notes.zh: 历史最高点。remain near its all-time high = 仍贴近历史新高。和 10/11 期美股晨读重复巩固。

notes.anchor: wavering between small gains and losses
notes.head: waver between A and B
notes.zh: 在 A 与 B 之间摇摆不定。写盘中反复翻红翻绿：waver / oscillate / pinball between gains and losses。

notes.head: benchmark
notes.zh: 基准（指数）。the benchmark index 常特指标普 500。benchmark rate = 基准利率。

notes.head: led by
notes.zh: 由…领涨/领跌。被动结构：Shares rose, led by X = 在 X 带动下上涨。财经开篇固定句式。

notes.anchor: dragged the market into the red
notes.head: into the red
notes.zh: 跌入亏损区、翻绿。drag A into the red = 把 A 拖进下跌。反义 into the black（翻红盈利）。

notes.head: give up (gains)
notes.zh: 回吐、跌去。gave up 1.3% = 跌了 1.3%（常暗示此前涨过又吐回去）。也说 gave back / surrendered。

notes.head: heavy influence
notes.zh: 重大影响。大市值股 have a heavy influence = 权重高、牵一发动全身。= outsized / outsize influence。

notes.head: driving force
notes.zh: 推动力、主力。the driving force behind the rally = 本轮上涨的核心推手。

notes.head: scrutiny
notes.zh: 严格审视、仔细核查。face scrutiny from investors = 面临投资者更严苛的拷问。财报季高频词。

notes.head: frenzy
notes.zh: 狂热、躁动。the AI frenzy = AI 热潮。带一点“过热”色彩，比 boom / boomlet 更口语夸张。

notes.head: translate into
notes.zh: 转化为、体现为。gains translate into growth = 涨幅能否变成真增长。商业英语固定搭配。

notes.head: reach for records
notes.zh: 一再冲击纪录高位。reach for = 伸手去够，喻股价不断试探新高。和 ran toward records 同族。

notes.anchor: very volatile on a daily basis
notes.head: volatile / on a daily basis
notes.zh: 波动剧烈的；按日计。on a daily basis = 日度层面。写“日线晃、趋势仍上”常用。

notes.head: settle at
notes.zh: 收于、定格在。oil settled at… = 结算/收盘价。与 10/11 期 settle at 巩固。

notes.head: swing between A and B
notes.zh: 在 A 与 B 之间大幅摆动。写油价/汇率区间震荡：swing / bounce / pinball between。

notes.head: key focus
notes.zh: 本周关键关注点。be a key focus = 成为市场盯盘核心。也说 top of mind / front and center。

notes.head: closely-watched
notes.zh: 备受关注的。closely-watched CPI / data / vote。和 high-profile 近义，偏“市场盯着看”。

notes.head: worsen to
notes.zh: 恶化至…。通胀“恶化”用 worsen（升到更高），冷却用 cool / ease。注意主语是 the rate of inflation。

review_words.example: The index spent the day wavering between gains and losses.
The benchmark index is still near its record high.
A slide in big tech dragged the market into the red.

review_words.zh: n. 仔细审视，严格核查
review_words.example: Chipmakers face more scrutiny during earnings season.
Stock gains came during the frenzy over artificial intelligence.
Can AI hype translate into future growth?
Markets remain very volatile on a daily basis.
Brent crude rose 1.8% to settle at $106.65.
Oil has been swinging between $96 and nearly $110.
The surge in energy prices will be a key focus.
Investors await the closely-watched consumer price index.
Economists expect inflation to have worsened to 3.6%.

patterns.pattern: A kicked off … with a mixed finish, although B remained …
patterns.zh: A 以涨跌互现收官开局，尽管 B 仍…
patterns.from: Wall Street kicked off a busy week on Monday with a mixed finish for the major U.S. stock indexes, although the market remained near its all-time high.
patterns.model: The team kicked off the season with a mixed finish, although morale remained high.
patterns.model_zh: 球队以胜负参半开季，尽管士气仍高。

patterns.pattern: Despite those gains, a slide in A dragged B into the red
patterns.zh: 尽管有那些涨幅，A 的下滑把 B 拖进下跌
patterns.from: Despite those gains, a slide in big technology stocks dragged the market into the red.
patterns.model: Despite those gains, a slide in cloud stocks dragged the Nasdaq into the red.
patterns.model_zh: 尽管有那些涨幅，云股下滑把纳指拖进下跌。

patterns.pattern: whether A can translate into B
patterns.from: …whether the stock gains made during the frenzy over artificial intelligence can translate into future growth.
patterns.model: Investors asked whether the user growth can translate into higher profits.
patterns.model_zh: 投资者追问用户增长能否转化为更高利润。

patterns.pattern: A will be a key focus … as B reviews C
patterns.zh: 在 B 审视 C 之际，A 将成为关键焦点
patterns.from: The surge in energy prices and its impact on the broader economy will be a key focus this week as Wall Street reviews several important economic updates.
patterns.model: Jobless claims will be a key focus this week as traders review the Fed minutes.
patterns.model_zh: 在交易员研读美联储纪要之际，初请失业金将成为本周关键焦点。

podcast.title: Outlooks, bank earnings, and a Nobel win
podcast.zh: 周一 Marketplace：通胀与利率展望、本周大银行财报，以及诺贝尔经济学奖。和今天 AP 收盘文同一天背景（油价、CPI、银行季报），适合泛听抓 bank earnings / rate hike 线索。
